/* saveAdminIp - Lee JiSeob */
MERGE INTO SAB960 /* 관리자 IP */ USING DUAL ON (IP_NO = #{IP_NO})
WHEN MATCHED THEN
UPDATE SET
IP_SE_NO1 = #{IP1}, IP_SE_NO2 = #{IP2}, IP_SE_NO3 = #{IP3}, IP_SE_NO4 = #{IP4},
USE_YN = #{USE_YN}, RM_DTL_CN = #{RM_DTL_CN},
LAST_MDFR_ID = #{USER_ID}, LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
INSERT ( IP_NO,
IP_SE_NO1, IP_SE_NO2, IP_SE_NO3, IP_SE_NO4,
USE_YN, RM_DTL_CN,
FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_REG_DT, LAST_MDFR_ID, LAST_MDFCN_DT ) VALUES ( SAB960_SQ01.NEXTVAL,
#{IP1}, #{IP2}, #{IP3}, #{IP4},
#{USE_YN}, #{RM_DTL_CN},
#{USER_ID}, SYSDATE, #{USER_ID}, SYSDATE )

/* selectAdminIp - Lee JiSeob */
SELECT
STNG_PARA_VALUE1, STNG_PARA_VALUE2, STNG_PARA_VALUE3, STNG_PARA_VALUE4, STNG_PARA_VALUE5, STNG_PARA_VALUE6, STNG_PARA_VALUE7, STNG_PARA_VALUE8, STNG_PARA_VALUE9, STNG_PARA_VALUE10,
FRST_RGTR_ID, TO_CHAR(FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS FRST_REG_DT, LAST_MDFR_ID, TO_CHAR(LAST_MDFCN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS LAST_MDFCN_DT
FROM SAB710 /* 환경설정 */
WHERE STNG_ID = 'ADMIN_IP' AND STNG_MNG_YN = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1

FRST_RGTR_ID, TO_CHAR(FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS FRST_REG_DT, LAST_MDFR_ID, TO_CHAR(LAST_MDFCN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS LAST_MDFCN_DT
FROM SAB710 /* 환경설정 */
WHERE STNG_ID = 'ADMIN_IP' AND STNG_MNG_YN = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1

SELECT

IP_SE_NO1 AS IP1, IP_SE_NO2 AS IP2, IP_SE_NO3 AS IP3, IP_SE_NO4 AS IP4,
